claims: AIPAC is the American Israel Public Affairs Committee.
AIPAC is a bipartisan pro-Israel lobbying group in the U.S.
AIPAC claims over 6 million members from across the United States.
AIPAC focuses on lobbying congress and the executive branch.
AIPAC funds candidates through its affiliated PAC and Super PAC, United Democracy Project.
AIPAC PAC directly contributes to political campaigns.
AIPAC PAC raises millions in funding.
AIPAC works through the United Democracy Project Super PAC.
AIPAC was founded in the 1950s as the American Zionist Committee for Public Affairs.
AIPAC shifted to its current name to better describe its focus on U.S.-Israel legislative affairs.
AIPAC engages with leaders in both the Democratic and Republican parties.
